$comment: Hand-written routing copy merged by scripts/gen-route-spec.mjs into plugins/opchain/hooks/route-spec.json. Rule (TypeSafe cookbook): describe the IDEA the user has, never the flag or parameter name. `index` is the ≤160-char option text in the request-1 Choice over all skills; `notFor` is appended in the request-2 rerank and fit questions where siblings confuse; `verbs` override derived command-reference lines; `verbQuestion` is the per-skill verb Choice prompt; `baseVerb` overrides the verb used when the request names no sub-task.

oc-agent-forge.index: Designing or building an agent on the Claude Agent SDK: subagent topology, tool budgets, harness loop shape, agent evals.
oc-agent-forge.notFor: Not raw Claude API mechanics such as prompt caching, tool-use schemas or model migration (oc-claude-api), and not prompt eval datasets (oc-prompt-ops).
oc-agent-forge.verbQuestion: Which part of the agent work does the request ask for: planning the topology, building it, evaluating or tracing it? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-api-dev.index: Designing, versioning, linting or generating SDKs for the project's own first-party API (OpenAPI/GraphQL); spec-vs-code drift.
oc-api-dev.notFor: Not consuming someone else's API, OAuth or webhooks (oc-integrations-engineer), and not warehouse or data schema drift (oc-data-ops).
oc-api-dev.verbQuestion: Which API task does the request ask for: designing, writing the spec, scaffolding handlers, versioning or deprecating, generating an SDK, checking drift? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-app-architect.index: Taking a product idea through discovery, spec, design, sprint plan, scaffold, build loop and launch; 'build me an app', 'I have an idea'.
oc-app-architect.notFor: Not a stack-only decision (oc-stack-forge), not UI design work on its own (oc-ux-engineer), not documenting an existing codebase (oc-reverse-spec), and not changing a live system's engine (oc-migration-ops).
oc-app-architect.verbQuestion: Which phase of the app pipeline does the request ask for: discovery interview, spec, design, sprint roadmap, scaffold, the build loop, or launch? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-bug-check.index: Fast checks on what is about to be committed: lint, types, tests, secrets, build; 'is this safe to commit?'. Also enrolling the commit gate.
oc-bug-check.notFor: Not a deliberate audit with a findings report and a fix loop (oc-code-auditor), not threat modelling or infrastructure security (oc-security-auditor), not test strategy (oc-qa-ops), not a question about whether the checks ran or belong in a plan, and not a message that only names the checks ("and bug check") without asking for a run.
oc-bug-check.verbQuestion: Does the request want the checks run, something auto-fixed, the gate configured, a report or history shown, the gate bypassed once, or the repo enrolled in the commit gate? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-enroll: Install the opchain commit gate in this repository so every commit is checked (enrollment, not a check run).
verbs./oc-bugcheck: Run all the pre-commit checks now on staged or changed files.

oc-checkpoint-protocol.index: The shared checkpoint JSON contract every other skill implements for session persistence; nothing a request invokes directly.

oc-claude-api.index: Writing, debugging or migrating code that calls the Claude API / Anthropic SDK: prompt caching, tool use, model versions, batches.
oc-claude-api.notFor: Not agent topology or harness design (oc-agent-forge), not prompt eval datasets (oc-prompt-ops), and not retrieval systems (oc-rag-forge).
oc-claude-api.verbQuestion: Does the request want a model-version migration, a prompt-cache audit, tool-use design, or a cost look at Claude API usage? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-claude-api tool-use: Schema-first tool-use patterns: defer-loaded and parallel tool definitions.

oc-code-auditor.index: A deliberate code-quality audit of a codebase, file or diff with a findings report and a fix/verify loop: 'audit this', 'find bugs', 'code review'.
oc-code-auditor.notFor: Not the fast pre-commit gate (oc-bug-check), not architecture or infrastructure security posture (oc-security-auditor), and not executing hardening fixes (oc-security-hardening).
oc-code-auditor.verbQuestion: What scope of audit does the request ask for: the full codebase, security, performance, quality, UX, a pre-deploy gate, a specific file, the diff; or fixing findings, verifying fixes, bootstrapping tests, or regenerating the report? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-audit: Audit without a stated scope; the auditor picks the sweep.

oc-compliance-ops.index: SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR compliance: the control register, audit-ready evidence bundles, policy docs, 'what would an auditor ask for'.
oc-compliance-ops.notFor: Not the point-in-time security assessment (oc-security-auditor) and not executing technical controls (oc-security-hardening).
oc-compliance-ops.verbQuestion: Does the request want the compliance scope set, the control register, an evidence bundle, the open gaps, policy documents, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-compliance: Alias of the compliance entry point.
verbs./oc-comply gaps: The open controls: unmapped, unsatisfied, or stale against the register.

oc-cost-ops.index: What LLM or token spend a skill phase, feature or run cost; budget gates in checkpoints; which model tier to route work to.
oc-cost-ops.notFor: Not prompt quality regression (oc-prompt-ops), not usage metering of which skills ran (oc-telemetry-ops), and not cloud infrastructure bills (oc-scale-ops).
oc-cost-ops.verbQuestion: Does the request want a cost baseline, spend attributed to phases, a budget set, model-tier routing advice, the budget gate checked, or a report? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-dash-forge.index: Designing a dashboard, BI view, KPI screen or dense data UI: a design spec plus a React prototype with mock data.
oc-dash-forge.notFor: Not general UI/UX design (oc-ux-engineer), not the metric backend that feeds it (oc-signal-forge), and not production monitoring itself (oc-monitoring-ops).
oc-dash-forge.verbQuestion: Which dashboard-design step does the request ask for: intake, picking the archetype, layout, tokens, the prototype, spec only, the full run, an audit of an existing dashboard, or variants? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-dash-forge: Start the dashboard design pipeline from the beginning.
verbs./oc-data-forge: Alias of the dashboard design entry point.

oc-data-ops.index: Designing or building data pipelines: ingestion, dbt/transform layers, warehouse modeling, data contracts, freshness and quality checks.
oc-data-ops.notFor: Not a single metric (oc-signal-forge), not dashboards (oc-dash-forge), not swapping a live pipeline engine (oc-migration-ops), and not API spec-vs-code drift (oc-api-dev).
oc-data-ops.verbQuestion: Does the request want the pipeline designed, data contracts written, the pipeline built, contracts verified, observability added, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-deploy-ops.index: Shipping a single managed app: deploy to staging or production, roll back, smoke tests, health check, environment config, deploy status.
oc-deploy-ops.notFor: Not commits, pushes, PRs or tags (oc-git-ops), not planning or cutting the release itself (oc-release-ops), not multi-container or IaC infrastructure (oc-fleet-ops), and not post-deploy monitoring (oc-monitoring-ops). A request to plan a release (what ships, in what order, to staging then production) is oc-release-ops even when it names staging or production; this skill runs a deploy the release plan already decided.
oc-deploy-ops.verbQuestion: Which deployment action does the request ask for: staging, production, rollback, the pre-deploy audit, smoke tests, a health check, environment variables, initial setup, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-docs-forge.index: Writing or refreshing the documentation a change needs: the PR docs packet, README, changelog, ADRs, product docs.
oc-docs-forge.notFor: Not generated-catalog or generated-file drift (oc-repo-ops) and not the commit/PR mechanics (oc-git-ops).
oc-docs-forge.verbQuestion: Does the request want the PR documentation packet, a README update, docs standardized, general docs upkeep, or docs verified? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-evolve.index: Reflecting on something that keeps going wrong in the workflow and proposing, evaluating or reviewing a learned behaviour rule.
oc-evolve.notFor: Not recalling past incidents or lessons (oc-hindsight).
oc-evolve.verbQuestion: Does the request want a reflection on recurring failures, or the status of proposed rules? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-evolve: Open the behaviour-improvement loop without a named step.
verbs./oc-evolve reflect: Look at what keeps going wrong and propose a rule change.
verbs./oc-evolve status: Show proposed and adopted rules and their evaluation state.

oc-fleet-ops.index: Deploying or operating many containers on self-managed infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Nomad, Compose, VMs, on-prem.
oc-fleet-ops.notFor: Not a single managed-platform app deploy (oc-deploy-ops).
oc-fleet-ops.verbQuestion: Which fleet action does the request ask for: declaring topology, provisioning infra, deploying, verifying, scaling, draining, rollback, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-git-ops.index: Git operations: branch, commit, push, open or merge a PR, the whole commit→push→PR sync, tag a merged release.
oc-git-ops.notFor: Not planning or drafting a versioned release (oc-release-ops), not deploying anything to an environment (oc-deploy-ops), not turning the coding assistant's Auto-fix or CI monitoring on or off, and not a question about whether a git step happened. Opening a PR is this skill whatever the PR is about; tagging an already-merged release IS this skill.
oc-git-ops.verbQuestion: What does the request want done with git: just a commit, a PR description, a push, the full commit→push→PR sync (which is what opening or raising a PR means), merging a reviewed PR (or arming auto-merge), or tagging a merged release? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-git: A git task with no specific step named: status, conventions, repo setup.
verbs./oc-merge: Merge a reviewed pull request, or arm auto-merge, under the repo's merge policy once its checks pass.
verbs./oc-git-sync: Open or raise a PR: branch, commit, push and create it in one run, whatever the PR is about.
verbs./oc-pr: Draft the PR description only, from the commits and checkpoints; it does not open the PR.

oc-hindsight.index: Operational memory: remember this failure or lesson, find a similar past incident, 'what did we learn last time'.
oc-hindsight.notFor: Not proposing or evaluating new behaviour rules (oc-evolve).
oc-hindsight.verbQuestion: Does the request want outcomes harvested into memory, or the memory's status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-hindsight: Retrieve or record an operational lesson without a named step.
verbs./oc-hindsight harvest: Harvest recent outcomes into candidate lessons.
verbs./oc-hindsight status: Show the lesson store: pending, approved, provenance.

oc-integrations-engineer.index: Connecting to someone else's API or service: OAuth, webhooks, retries, secrets, health — Stripe, Slack, Salesforce-style integrations.
oc-integrations-engineer.notFor: Not the project's own first-party API design (oc-api-dev) and not the warehouse pipeline a connector feeds (oc-data-ops).
oc-integrations-engineer.verbQuestion: Which integration step does the request ask for: planning, secrets, building, testing, connecting, a webhook, OAuth, health, retry policy, or listing integrations? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-migration-ops.index: Changing a live system from one engine to another: database or framework migration, auth provider swap, platform move, big version upgrade.
oc-migration-ops.notFor: Not greenfield building (oc-app-architect), not documenting what exists (oc-reverse-spec), and not decomposing a live monolith into services (oc-modularize-ops).
oc-migration-ops.verbQuestion: Where in the migration is the request: assessing, planning, impact analysis, executing, a single step, verifying, rollback, dry run, status, history, an opchain ecosystem upgrade, or abandoning? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-modularize-ops.index: Breaking a live monolith into modules or services with golden fixtures from real data proving zero behaviour loss; willing to say don't.
oc-modularize-ops.notFor: Not a behaviour-preserving, git-diffable repo or package reorg (oc-migration-ops) and not deploying the resulting modules (oc-fleet-ops).
oc-modularize-ops.verbQuestion: Which decomposition step does the request ask for: assessing whether to do it, capturing golden fixtures, planning seams, extracting a module, verifying, diffing, status, or abandoning? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-modularize characterize: Capture golden fixtures from real data at every module boundary (the equivalence oracle).

oc-monitoring-ops.index: Production observability after a deploy: uptime, error tracking, logging, alerts, SLOs, on-call, incidents, runbooks, 'is prod healthy'.
oc-monitoring-ops.notFor: Not metering which opchain skills ran (oc-telemetry-ops) and not the deploy itself (oc-deploy-ops).
oc-monitoring-ops.verbQuestion: Which observability task does the request ask for: setup, choosing the stack, instrumenting, health, errors, uptime, metrics, alerts, on-call, SLOs, an incident, a runbook, a postmortem, a dashboard, a report, an audit, a comparison, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-orchestrator.index: Where things stand across the pipeline or across projects: status, what to work on next, blockers, routing a vague request to the right skill.
oc-orchestrator.notFor: Not performing the git, deploy or release work itself; it reports state and routes.
oc-orchestrator.verbQuestion: Does the request want status, the next action, routing of a vague intent, project registry work, the pipeline view, blockers, recent activity, health, or the skill list? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-ops switch: Set the active project for this session.

oc-prompt-ops.index: Treating LLM prompts as versioned code: eval datasets, golden sets, judging, regression and drift detection between prompt versions.
oc-prompt-ops.notFor: Not cost attribution (oc-cost-ops) and not retrieval evaluation (oc-rag-forge).
oc-prompt-ops.verbQuestion: Does the request want an eval run, a prompt diff, a golden set, a judge, a regression check, a baseline, or drift detection? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-qa-ops.index: Test strategy rather than test runs: the test pyramid, coverage budgets, contract-test matrix, load-test planning, flaky and slow test debt.
oc-qa-ops.notFor: Not running the tests (oc-bug-check), not executing load tests (oc-scale-ops), and not writing the tests themselves.
oc-qa-ops.verbQuestion: Does the request want the test pyramid, coverage budgets, the contract-test matrix, a load-test plan, an audit of the existing suite, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-rag-forge.index: Designing or building retrieval-augmented generation: vector DB choice, embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, reranking, retrieval eval.
oc-rag-forge.notFor: Not general Claude API code (oc-claude-api) and not prompt regression suites (oc-prompt-ops).
oc-rag-forge.verbQuestion: Which RAG step does the request ask for: design, build, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, a golden set, eval, benchmark, regression, or inspecting retrievals? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-release-ops.index: Planning or cutting a release: what ships to staging then production, the next semver, changelog, version bumps, announcement, verify, ship.
oc-release-ops.notFor: Not the git mechanics of committing, pushing or tagging (oc-git-ops) and not deploying the built artifact to an environment (oc-deploy-ops). Planning which commits ship, and in what order to staging then production, IS this skill, even when the request names the environments.
oc-release-ops.verbQuestion: Where in the release is the request: planning the semver, drafting the changelog, bumping versions, the announcement, the pre-ship verify, shipping the whole pipeline, rollback of the bump, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-release plan: Plan a release: decide what ships and the order it goes to staging then production; proposes the next semver.

oc-repo-ops.index: Repository hygiene before a PR: generated-file and catalog drift, stale artifacts, orphaned docs, .gitignore policy, 'is this PR ready'.
oc-repo-ops.notFor: Not writing the documentation itself (oc-docs-forge) and not the commit/PR mechanics (oc-git-ops).
oc-repo-ops.verbQuestion: Does the request want a hygiene audit, PR-readiness verification, cleanup, catalog regeneration, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-reverse-spec.index: Reverse-engineering an existing codebase into spec documents: inventory scan, full spec set, design-system extraction, stack gaps, sprint onramp.
oc-reverse-spec.notFor: Not building something new (oc-app-architect) and not changing the existing system (oc-migration-ops).
oc-reverse-spec.verbQuestion: Does the request want a quick scan, the full spec set, the design system extracted, the stack gap analysis, or a sprint onramp for one feature? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-scale-ops.index: Scaling readiness: load tests, performance budgets, bottlenecks, caching strategy, query and CDN tuning, capacity and infra cost planning.
oc-scale-ops.notFor: Not test strategy (oc-qa-ops), not production monitoring (oc-monitoring-ops), and not LLM token cost (oc-cost-ops).
oc-scale-ops.verbQuestion: Which scaling task does the request ask for: an audit, perf budgets, a load test, a bottleneck hunt, a benchmark, caching, queries, CDN, a capacity plan, or infra cost? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-security-auditor.index: Assessing security posture above the code: threat model, OWASP mapping, attack surface, framework readiness, headers/TLS/DNS/WAF review.
oc-security-auditor.notFor: Not code-level bug finding (oc-code-auditor), not pre-commit checks (oc-bug-check), not applying the fixes (oc-security-hardening), and not the standing compliance register (oc-compliance-ops).
oc-security-auditor.verbQuestion: Which assessment does the request ask for: the full posture, a threat model, attack surface, adversaries, data flow, OWASP, framework readiness, headers, TLS, DNS, Cloudflare, infra, a comparison of snapshots, prioritization, or the report? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-security: A security assessment with no specific pillar named.
verbs./oc-secaudit: Alias of the security assessment entry point.
verbs./oc-sec: Alias of the security assessment entry point.
verbs./oc-threat-model: Alias of the STRIDE threat model.
verbs./oc-owasp: Alias of the OWASP Top 10 checklist.
verbs./oc-hardening: Alias of the infrastructure hardening audit (assessment, not fixes).
verbs./oc-posture: Alias of the full posture assessment.

oc-security-hardening.index: Executing security fixes: add headers, roll out CSP in stages, rate limits, TLS/WAF config as code, rotate secrets, a per-deploy hardening gate.
oc-security-hardening.notFor: Not assessment or threat modelling (oc-security-auditor), not code-bug fixing (oc-code-auditor), and not dependency vulnerability scanning (oc-bug-check).
oc-security-hardening.verbQuestion: Does the request want the hardening baseline, a fix applied, the CSP rollout, the deploy gate, verification, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-signal-forge.index: Turning a question into a trustworthy metric: instrument, harvest, verify the signal actually answers it, then wire it to a consumer.
oc-signal-forge.notFor: Not opchain skill-usage telemetry (oc-telemetry-ops), not dashboards (oc-dash-forge), not production uptime (oc-monitoring-ops), and not estate-level data pipelines (oc-data-ops).
oc-signal-forge.verbQuestion: Which signal step does the request ask for: framing the question, design, harvesting, building, verifying, wiring to a consumer, the catalog, or status? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-stack-forge.index: Choosing the tech stack or platform (Cloudflare, Vercel, AWS, Supabase, Rails...) or decomposing a feature into stack-ordered sprints.
oc-stack-forge.notFor: Not the full idea-to-launch pipeline (oc-app-architect) and not UI/UX design (oc-ux-engineer).
oc-stack-forge.verbQuestion: Does the request want the stack decision tree run, or a feature decomposed into stack-ordered sprints? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-stack: A stack question with no specific step named.

oc-telemetry-ops.index: Opt-in, local metering of which opchain skills and phases actually run; usage stats and anonymized aggregate exports.
oc-telemetry-ops.notFor: Not application or production observability (oc-monitoring-ops) and not cost attribution (oc-cost-ops).
oc-telemetry-ops.verbQuestion: Does the request want telemetry enabled, disabled, its status, an event recorded, aggregates, or an export? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

oc-update.index: Updating the opchain skills installed in this repository, or checking whether a newer opchain version exists.
oc-update.notFor: Not upgrading the project's own dependencies or frameworks (oc-migration-ops).
oc-update.verbQuestion: Does the request want the update applied, only a check for whether one exists, or a diagnosis of which opchain copy the session loads? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

verbs./oc-update: Apply the opchain skill update, preserving checkpoints and telemetry.
verbs./oc-update check: Only check whether an opchain update is available.
verbs./oc-update doctor: Diagnose which opchain install this session loads and why there are duplicate copies (read-only).

oc-ux-engineer.index: UI/UX design work: plan, generate and evaluate screens, user flows, the component library, accessibility audit, design consistency.
oc-ux-engineer.notFor: Not the whole app pipeline (oc-app-architect), not stack choice (oc-stack-forge), and not dashboards or dense data UIs (oc-dash-forge).
oc-ux-engineer.verbQuestion: Which design step does the request ask for: planning, the build loop, an evaluation, user flows, components, fidelity against design, routing to dashboard design, attaching or detaching the evaluator, status, or export? Choose "unspecified" when it names none.

suggest.reason: Evidence gate. The router may SUGGEST only these skills: the seven core pipeline skills (git-ops 0.92 / deploy-ops 0.88 precision in the 2026-10-09 blind-labelled eval of 574 prompts) plus the skills that had labelled positives in that eval (oc-app-architect, oc-ux-engineer, oc-orchestrator, oc-dash-forge, oc-update). Every other skill was noisy and 11 produced suggestions with zero labelled positives. All skills stay as Choice options so they absorb probability instead of misrouting to oc-git-ops; a winner outside this list yields no suggestion. A skill joins the list when an eval or `route-eval outcomes` shows labelled positives for it.
